title: Wire a Counter Button
prompt:
You have `button` (a button element) and `display` (a span). Make the button clicks count: keep a `count` variable, listen for `click`, and show the new value in `display` on every click. Then simulate two clicks by calling the handler logic twice, and log the display text (should be `2`).

Rules:
- `addEventListener("click", …)` on the button.
- The display updates inside the handler.

tests.name: click listener registered
display updates inside the handler
tests.hint: The handler body must include display.textContent = count; (after incrementing).

tests.name: two simulated clicks show 2
tests.hint: Call the handler twice, then log display.textContent — it should read 2.
